schema.name: dvmf_cor939
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE dvmf_cor939.parent (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)
CREATE TABLE dvmf_cor939.left_leaf (id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT, score INT)
CREATE TABLE dvmf_cor939.right_leaf (id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT, rating INT)

query.defining_query: WITH al AS (SELECT parent_id, sum(score) AS sum_s, count(*) AS cnt_l FROM dvmf_cor939.left_leaf GROUP BY parent_id), ar AS (SELECT parent_id, avg(rating) AS avg_r, count(*) AS cnt_r FROM dvmf_cor939.right_leaf GROUP BY parent_id) SELECT p.id, p.name, al.sum_s, al.cnt_l, ar.avg_r, ar.cnt_r FROM dvmf_cor939.parent p LEFT JOIN al ON al.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ar ON ar.parent_id = p.id

mutations.sql: UPDATE dvmf_cor939.right_leaf SET rating = 3 WHERE id = 1 RETURNING 1
